# Dr Buttons Integrative Health

> Dr Buttons Integrative Health is an Australian telehealth clinic. It offers phone consultations with registered Australian doctors, and doctor-led support to quit smoking or vaping. Tagline: Where Science Meets Wellness.

## Services
- [Doctor consultation](https://drbuttons.com.au/services/doctor-consultation/): Talk to a registered doctor, from home. Your doctor reviews your history and talks through your options with you by phone.
- [Quit smoking support](https://drbuttons.com.au/services/quit-smoking-support/): A doctor works with you on a quit plan that fits your goals, with follow-ups to help you stay on track.

## Key facts
- Phone consultations available Australia-wide.
- Every consultation is with an AHPRA-registered doctor.
- A few short questions help book the right appointment and brief the doctor. They are not a diagnosis and do not decide treatment. A registered doctor decides everything in a real-time consultation.
- The $0 fee covers your initial telehealth consultation. If your doctor recommends treatment, any costs are explained to you before you agree to anything.
- Health information is stored securely, hosted in Australia, and handled under the Australian Privacy Principles.
